title: A rectangle rounds on the grid the way a drawn shape does
goal: With the grid on, pulling a corner on a shape drawn with the Pen lands on grid steps and Command frees it, but pulling a corner on a rectangle ignores the grid. Someone rounding an icon on a grid gets radii that do not line up, depending on which kind of shape they picked.
notes: Seen while building rounding-corners-works-the-same-way-on-a-rectang. Reading the code: CanvasPathCorners.pathCornerMouseDragged runs the radius through PathContent.landedCornerRadius with canvasNudgeGrid spacing, the rectangle branch in CanvasPointerDrags.mouseDragged (cornerRadiusDrag) only rounds to whole points in CornerRadiusHandles.radius. Shown by round-a-path-s-corners-walk stage 7-grid (a pull asking 50.6 lands on 64); Reproduced 2026-11-07 with a throwaway walk: blank 900x600, draw a rectangle 320,260 to 600,460, selectCanvas, press Show grid, click the rectangle, drag the top left dot 332,272 to 370,310 with readout "Radius 50" and expect Corner Radius reads 50. Scripts/playtest.sh /tmp/rect-on-grid-walk.json --no-build printed exit 0, status ok, 15 steps: the rectangle landed on 50 with the grid on, where the path walk lands the same size of pull on 64.
acceptance: With the grid on, a pull on a rectangle corner dot lands on the same grid steps a drawn shape knob lands on, and the pill reads that number
Holding Command frees the pull from the grid on a rectangle, as it does on a drawn shape
A walk at Next defaults proves both
